### `POST /cluster/jobs/realm-sync/{id}`

```ts
proxmox.cluster.jobs["realm-sync"].$(id).$post()
```

Create new realm-sync job.

Returns nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string |  | Description for the Job. — ≤ 512 chars |
| `enable-new` | boolean |  | Enable newly synced users immediately. — default `"1"` |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | Determines if the job is enabled. — default `1` |
| `id` | string | yes | The ID of the job. — format `pve-configid`, ≤ 64 chars |
| `realm` | string |  | Authentication domain ID — format `pve-realm`, ≤ 32 chars |
| `remove-vanished` | string |  | A semicolon-separated list of things to remove when they or the user vanishes during a sync. The following values are possible: 'entry' removes the user/group when not returned from the sync. 'properties' removes the set properties on existing user/group that do not appear in the source (even custom ones). 'acl' removes acls when the user/group is not returned from the sync. Instead of a list it also can be 'none' (the default). — default `"none"` |
| `schedule` | string | yes | Backup schedule. The format is a subset of `systemd` calendar events. — format `pve-calendar-event`, ≤ 128 chars |
| `scope` | `users` \| `groups` \| `both` |  | Select what to sync. |
